# CAT Rig Lab 3D assets

- `night-striker.glb` is a static presentation copy of **Superhero Male FullBody** from Quaternius, Universal Base Characters (Standard). The creator publishes this pack under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html. This file was obtained from the public `blood-league-kickoff` mirror, which identifies its source and license in `docs/ASSET_CREDITS.md`.
- `GLTFLoader.js` and `BufferGeometryUtils.js` come from three.js r180, licensed under MIT. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/examples/jsm. The loader's local import path was adjusted to keep both modules together. The project already includes `vendor/LICENSE-three.txt`.

The GLB is shown only as a visual mesh in the lab. Its original internal skeleton is not used as the CAT rig.
